scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
